activation_gates: Visually review every frame, both-step loaded gait, turn/hold/action joins and first-last loop.
Check native hands/grips against separately owned sack/cloth/stone/cup/tool objects in actual Game; no anatomy stretch.
Verify rear/side prop occlusion and blocked holds, interruption/cancel, region streaming and Save/Continue.
Keep old durable milestones and logical metadata unless a specific reviewed correction is needed.
canvas_geometry: Art-only padding grows40x44 to48x52, with anchor20,38 ->24,46; body-to-ground transform and world attachment offsets are unchanged. Padding restores full source crowns instead of clipping high cells.
limits: Retained complete source bodies re-sampled uniformly at2x. No runtime binding, prop ownership, hand metadata, timing, collision or save changes; props remain separately owned. Not a user visual approval.
